hints: Start from the loop nest in the lesson: `%i = range 2`, `%j = range 3` and the offset `%o = add %i3 %j` with `%i3 = mul %i 3`.
Load the grid element through `shrink %g %o []` and the bias element through `shrink %bias %j []`. Add the two loads and store the sum into `shrink %out %o []`.
Close the inner loop first: `%ej = end %s %j`, then `%ei = end %ej %i`, then `%out1 = after %out %ei`.

answer.code:
%g    = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=0
%bias = buffer 3 dtype=i32 slot=1
%out  = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=2
%i    = range 2
%j    = range 3
%i3   = mul %i 3
%o    = add %i3 %j
%gv   = shrink %g %o []
%x    = load %gv
%bv   = shrink %bias %j []
%y    = load %bv
%sum  = add %x %y
%ov   = shrink %out %o []
%s    = store %ov %sum
%ej   = end %s %j
%ei   = end %ej %i
%out1 = after %out %ei
answer.explain: Two ranges walk the grid: `%i` over the 2 rows and `%j` over the 3 columns. The offset `i*3 + j` picks the grid element and the output element, and `%j` alone picks the bias element. The store depends on both ranges, so it takes two `end`s: `%j` is closed first and is the inner loop.
